policy: Only official course equivalencies are treated as completed courses. Placement-only and attainment-exam outcomes require confirmation.

03-121: AP Biology: 4 or 5 plus CMU attainment exam
IB Biology HL: 6 or 7 plus CMU attainment exam

non_equivalent_awards.85-110/85-150/85-213: AP Psychology and IB Psychology award 85-011/85-012; the catalog does not list them as direct substitutes for these HCI/AI choices.
non_equivalent_awards.21-127/21-128/15-151: No direct AP/IB course equivalency is listed; placement or advisor-approved transfer credit must be recorded separately.
non_equivalent_awards.upper_level_courses: CMU's published AP/IB tables do not directly award the 200–500 level program core courses not explicitly listed above.
